headline: Dawn sits on the opposite roof.
body: The tiles take a dull silver and give nothing back. A shutter two floors down goes up, then down again. We keep the page where the last sentence stopped.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: dull silver on tiles, no sun yet

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: stairwell still on, a tired yellow

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: shutter up, then down, no one out
